name: First design
changes: The same page layout, with PT Sans, regular-weight headings, and white space around the text.
The board has a caption. The introduction explains the actual work without a slogan.
Images keep their own proportions. Project names use ordinary text links.
The typography and link styling carry through to the original technical writeup.

name: Workbench
changes: A project explorer with a sidebar and an inspection pane.
Select a project without leaving the collection.
Inspect the actual technology stack, then narrow the project list.
Open the complete writeup when you want more detail.

name: Gallery
changes: A blue masthead, large typography, and a gallery of real project images.
Different image sizes give the work room to breathe.
Browse a project type, with short captions beside the screenshots.
Each project opens into its own page with the full writeup.

name: Personal Index
changes: A brief personal introduction and a compact index of all 17 projects.
Expand a project to see its image, summary, and technologies.
Search by name or technology; the list narrows as you type.
Open a full project page from an expanded row.
